fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal politics and an upcoming election, criticism of public-utility practices and metering, and discussion of Florida Power & Light Company and city bus service finances. Coverage also addresses state gasoline-tax and road-funding allocations affecting Dade County, reports and commentary on the Dade County Fair, and recurring satirical columns and local humor. Additional items touch on prohibition enforcement, transportation/express delivery charges, and Miami-area entertainment and nightlife notices.
